newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Trans-Asia says 95-96 net more than doubles.
newsitem.headline: Trans-Asia says 95-96 net more than doubles.

text.p: Philippine oil explorer Trans-Asia Oil and Mineral Development Corp said on Thursday its net income in the 1995/96 fiscal year (September-August) rose to 105.4 million pesos against the year-ago 44 million pesos.
It said consolidated revenues went up to 148 million pesos in the period from 63.5 million pesos.
The company said in a statement that its total consolidated current assets were 501.1 million pesos at the end of the period. while total debt was 29.2 million pesos.
The company said on Wednesday that its stockholders had approved a 10 percent stock dividend to shareholders on record on January 31, payable on February 14.
The company also said it would raise the par value of its share to one peso from the current one centavo, after receiving approval from the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Trans-Asia shares closed on Thursday at 1.4 centavos, up 0.1 centavos.
